properties.displayName: [Baseline] Storage accounts should disallow public blob access
properties.description: Denies storage accounts that permit anonymous public read access to containers and blobs. Anonymous access is a leading cause of accidental data exposure; requiring allowBlobPublicAccess to be explicitly false forces intentional, account-level opt-out. Accounts that omit the property are flagged because older API versions default it to enabled.

metadata.description: The effect the policy applies when a storage account permits public blob access.
